summary: Ecovyst Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Fourth Amendment to its Term Loan Credit Agreement to borrow an incremental $100.0 million first lien term loan. Proceeds financed the previously announced acquisition of the entire issued share capital of INEOS Calabrian Holdings Corp. (US target) and INEOS Calabrian Corporation Canada, Inc. (Canadian target). The incremental term loan bears interest at Term SOFR +2.00% or ABR +1.00%, with amortization, maturity, and collateral identical to existing initial term loans. The amendment was executed on June 30, 2026. Watch for closing conditions and integration risk; no premium or board recommendation detailed.
